verdict.rationale: Zulip's export documentation explicitly describes exporting full message history including private channel messages and direct messages when members consent, and organization data export is a first-party admin tool producing machine-readable data for self-hosting/migration purposes. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the export format's completeness and no explicit mention of export file format details (e.g., JSON structure) or audit-log-specific compliance features.
